memory-lifecycle.title: Choose the right lifetime
memory-lifecycle.subtitle: Current-chat material, saved references, and memory have different controls.
memory-lifecycle.note: Inspect, correct, or remove saved material in Memory and Knowledge. Saving does not guarantee delivery.

watch-goal-schedule.title: Choose what starts the work
watch-goal-schedule.subtitle: Use the smallest mechanism that fits the task.
rows: Notify or act on the change
Stop on completion or a limit
watch-goal-schedule.note: The server must be running. Check schedule recovery and goal iteration limits in the linked guides.

plugin-boundaries.title: Plugin code crosses two different boundaries
plugin-boundaries.subtitle: Backend Python is trusted server code; the view uses the iframe bridge.
plugin-boundaries.note: Python plugins run with server privileges. An iframe boundary does not sandbox the plugin backend.

deployment-topology.title: The server owns the agent and its data
deployment-topology.subtitle: Choose a deployment; the browser is a client in each case.
deployment-topology.note: Protect remote access with authentication. Keep storage beside the server; back up its instance data.

box-instance-paths.title: One box, separate instance roots
box-instance-paths.subtitle: Example: PROTOAGENT_BOX_ROOT=/srv/agents with alice and bob instance IDs.
box-instance-paths.note: commons/ is opt-in shared material. PROTOAGENT_HOME overrides the instance root; check store overrides too.

exposure-boundaries.title: Route public traffic deliberately
exposure-boundaries.subtitle: A proxy rule and an application credential solve different problems.
exposure-boundaries.note: Keep the agent privately bound. Public plugin routes are deliberate exceptions, not a reason to expose /api.

config-precedence.title: Settings resolve through three layers
config-precedence.subtitle: Later configured values override earlier layers; nested maps merge and lists replace.
config-precedence.note: Environment rules are field-specific; they are not one universal final layer. Secrets use separate overlays.

a2a-task-lifecycle.title: A task can finish or pause for input
a2a-task-lifecycle.subtitle: A paused task is not a completed result.
rows: Follow up in the same context
a2a-task-lifecycle.note: Restart reconciliation fails interrupted work but preserves input/auth pauses. Terminal retention is 24 hours.
